covenants.name: consolidated fixed charge coverage ratio
covenants.quote: The Credit Agreement contains certain covenants, including limitations on subsidiary indebtedness, a minimum consolidated fixed charge coverage ratio of 2.50 :1.00 and a maximum consolidated leverage ratio of 3.50 :1.00.

covenants.name: consolidated leverage ratio
covenants.quote: We had a consolidated fixed charge coverage ratio of 6.11 times and 6.02 times as of June 30, 2026 and 2025, respectively, and a consolidated leverage ratio of 2.07 times
